hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults, implementing a proprietary bonding curve. All swaps are fully handled in `beforeSwap` via `BeforeSwapDelta`, bypassing Uniswap v4's native CLAMM pricing. Prevents direct LP positions, non-factory initializations, and donations to protect users from non-productive or irrecoverable fund loss.
